environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with direct TCP passthrough on port 443. WebSocket connections terminate at the application. Database is PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with pgBouncer in transaction pooling mode (pool_mode=transaction) on port 6432. No WAF or API Gateway in front of the NLB. Socket.IO CORS is set to allow all origins. The pgBouncer configuration uses transaction mode which does NOT support prepared statements - all queries are sent as simple protocol text queries directly to PostgreSQL.
